create_atari_ppo_model_nature: create an AtariPPOModel with the NatureCNN backbone for a given number of discrete actions
create_atari_ppo_model_impala: create an AtariPPOModel with the ImpalaCNN backbone for a given number of discrete actions
forward_atari_ppo_model: run the forward pass of AtariPPOModel to get log probabilities and value estimates from observations
act_atari_ppo_model: call the act method of AtariPPOModel to select actions with optional deterministic policy support
review_atari_ppo_model: review the AtariPPOModel class and its use of NatureCNN or ImpalaCNN backbones with a discrete actor-critic head
